identity_notes: Historical saved-workspace art1 IDs, where attached, come from /tmp/atlas-codara-container-wave/artifacts-final.jsonl and are not a fresh native census or a reissued current classification.

Runtime inventory ArtifactIds are separately path-derived by adapter/src/source/mod.rs::artifact_id; physical moves require an explicit reviewed preservation/relocation plan, not claims of automatic stable runtime IDs.
Construction module/report IDs hash compact serialized structs with their own ID cleared; historical field ordering and identity prefixes remain frozen.
Historical MATERIALIZER_IDENTITY atlas_core::atlasx::materialize is persisted data, not a live module locator to rename.

recommendation.smallest_real_move: Move the implementation in adapter/runtime/src/atlasx.rs into an actual runtime::codara::artifact residence, switch current CLI production callers to it, retain the existing runtime::atlasx public compatibility route without a second implementation.
recommendation.conditional_identity_gate: Freeze source/fixture hashes and historical IDs first; use established engine-owned saved-workspace ID relocation, retain an old-locator compatibility route, and explicitly account for path-derived runtime inventory identity/provenance changes. No new shared identity schema is proposed.
excluded: No native output-format or receipt redesign
No broad move of design/seal/verification or source extractor families
No simultaneous atlas.rs or self_reconstruction.rs move
No deletion of legacy CLI spelling, .atlas/.atlasx bytes, v1 receipts or fixture corpus
recommendation.important_test_selector_gate: Module moves change libtest-qualified names. Require actual execution of the new selector set; a zero-test success under retired atlasx:: must not qualify. Historical pinned instructions remain historical.

baseline_pin_correction.reason: Two CLI file pins initially read concurrent working-tree capacity changes; replaced with immutable commit contents and regenerated CLI locators/reference index.
